titulo: Josephus problem with a circular list
enunciado: Seven people (1 to 7) stand in a circle; starting at person 1 you count in steps of 3 and remove whoever is reached. Use a circular linked list (the last node points to the first) to show the removal order and the survivor.
pistas: Keep a reference to the node BEFORE the current one so you can remove.
Stop when a node points to itself.
